messages:
olivia: Heads-up — I'm splitting the networking module into networking/core and networking/aws. PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842. Main concern: provider version pin + lockfile churn. Plan is to hoist the root aws provider to avoid duplicate provider blocks. PTAL when you have a min.

sam: Which aws provider version are we targeting? current modules reference ~> 5.15 in a few places. moving to 5.20 ok?

lee: I ran a quick local test pinned to 5.20.0 — terraform init wants to update the providers.lock. Also watch for provider aliasing when modules expect different regions.

tanvi: One quick flag: secrets wiring — the old monolith module consumed a `secrets_map` and some callers rely on exact var names. If the split renames inputs we'll break callers. Can we keep input names stable?

olivia: Yes — plan is to keep var names identical. Add a tiny shim in networking/core that maps deprecated var names to the new ones for ~2 weeks, then remove. Also adding provider alias examples in the README. I added a short plan output to the PR for staging.

sam: Can you paste the provider block you're hoisting so I can sanity-check the version/aliasing?

olivia: ```
provider "aws" {
  version = "5.20.0"
  region  = var.region
}

provider "aws" {
  alias   = "us_east_1"
  region  = "us-east-1"
  version = "5.20.0"
}
```

lee: Two notes: 1) If modules still declare their own `provider` blocks that can cause duplication — we should remove provider blocks from the child modules or document `providers = { aws = aws }` usage. 2) For the lockfile, CI should run `terraform providers lock` with the proper `-platform` targets (we need linux_amd64 + linux_arm64 for our runners).

tanvi: On secrets: core module will accept `secrets_map` and forward to networking/aws which will read `secrets_map["vpc"]`. I'll add a short compatibility test so callers don't regress.

sam: Can we get a quick smoke plan from staging to ensure no churn?

olivia: ```
$ terraform plan -var-file=env/staging.tfvars
Refreshing Terraform state in-memory...
No changes. Infrastructure is up-to-date.
Plan: 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
```

tf-bot: CI: terraform plan completed for branch feature/networking-split — no diffs in staging. Apply gated by infra canary policy. :lock:

lee: LGTM from me if the CI matrix includes terraform 1.5.7 and the two provider platforms. Also please run tflint.

sam: Kicking off CI run with tf 1.5.7 + providers 5.20 on both platforms now. Will report back.

olivia: Thanks all — holding merge until CI + providers.lock bump in repo root. I'll add rollback instructions in the PR (how to pin back to 5.15 and revert the hoist). :thumbsup:
